01 / Why Coimbra

A university city that turns research into companies.

Coimbra's technology story is unusually concentrated: the University, Instituto Pedro Nunes, and a network of founders sit within minutes of one another. That closeness has helped ideas move from research benches into global products.

This atlas focuses on companies with a verified Coimbra presence or headquarters. It spans established exporters and younger specialists, and links every profile back to a primary or ecosystem source.

560+ companies legally formed through the IPN incubator, 1996–2024 Source: IPN ↗

Ecosystem spotlight / 2026

GO
COIMBRA

Municipal agency for
investment & innovation

A front door for the ecosystem

Turning Coimbra’s knowledge into opportunity.

Go Coimbra is the evolution of the municipal company iParque into a wider investment and innovation agency. It is designed as a single point of entry for companies and investors seeking to establish, expand or develop projects in Coimbra—connecting them with the municipality, research institutions and the wider business ecosystem.

01

Invest & grow

Attract new investment, help companies already in Coimbra expand, and improve access to business locations and infrastructure.

02

Test & accelerate

Use the territory as an innovation sandbox for real-world solutions across health, pharma, aerospace, green economy and technology.

03

Connect the system

Bring science, talent, companies, capital and the public sector into a more coordinated platform for qualified growth.

04

Project Coimbra

Build national and international partnerships and practise two-way economic diplomacy: Coimbra to the world, and the world to Coimbra.

In motion Coimbra Supernova

Go Coimbra operationally coordinates the space-sector alliance linking local research, institutions and companies.

Read the municipal update ↗
International stage “We have it all”

At Web Summit 2026, Go Coimbra joins the University, IPN and the metropolitan region to showcase 12 regional startups.

Go Coimbra remains a municipal company, majority-owned by the Municipality of Coimbra. Its expanded remit includes investment support, innovation, entrepreneurship, technology transfer, business-area management and international promotion.
